A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Pricing questions,
answered.

The details behind each plan.

How do AI credits work?+

Credits cover AI generation and follow-up edits. The amount used depends on the request, so a credit isn’t a fixed number of pages or websites. These launch allowances are provisional; we’ll publish the final credit usage rules before paid plans become available.

Do I get a year of credits all at once?+

No. Basic gets 1,000 credits each month and Pro gets 3,000, whether you pay monthly or yearly. Free includes a one-time allowance of 500 credits to try the builder.

Is a custom domain included in the price?+

Connecting a custom domain is included with Basic and Pro. The domain itself is a separate purchase, with its own registration and renewal price. When custom-domain publishing launches, you will be able to keep a domain with your existing provider or purchase one through Draftmango. Free published sites use a Draftmango subdomain where account access is enabled. Domain purchases are not live yet.

What’s the difference between monthly and yearly?+

Monthly billing is $15 for Basic or $39 for Pro each month. Yearly billing is one payment of $120 for Basic or $360 for Pro, equivalent to $10 or $30 per month. Site and monthly credit allowances stay the same.

Can I subscribe or publish right now?+

This is a preview of our launch plans. AI building, code editing and exports are implemented for restricted testing. Public account sign-up is currently closed while email delivery is prepared. Paid subscriptions are not active yet. Static-site publishing is enabled for restricted account testing. Choosing a plan takes you to sign-up and does not create a subscription or charge you.
